notes.title: Version 1.02 Release
notes.notes:
The following issues have been fixed:
・Fixed a bug where the "Last One" animation would remain displayed and transition to the next action under certain conditions.
・Fixed the issue so that the game does not pause when clicking outside the window in windowed mode.

notes.title: Version 1.01 Release
notes.notes:
An issue occurred under certain conditions where players could endlessly earn scores using the "high-rating gimmick" and "fan favorite," so we have adjusted the specifications of the high-rating gimmick.

Changes:
The conditions for earning high ratings have been changed so that hitting the high-rating gimmick now occurs when the listener is hit even once.
Due to the changes in conditions, the score added when hitting the high-rating gimmick has been increased.

We have addressed a bug where scores were not correctly added in certain languages (currently under behavior verification).(Note: Fix confirmed on 9/9).
